title: Harbor Card (Phase 2)
description: Ed25519-signed JWT issued by a daemon (root CA per Anchor Protocol §2.2). Used as proof-of-bearer when a daemon connects outbound to the relay or when an agent acts within a harbor.

iss.description: Daemon fingerprint (hash of Ed25519 public key)

exp.description: Expiry (unix seconds); short for relay use (<= 3600)

jti.description: Unique token id; appears in revocation list if revoked

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the harbor's Ed25519 public key (lowercase hex)

channel.description: Channel pattern; supports * suffix for prefix match

lhb.description: Last-heartbeat-by; relay drops connection if exceeded

kid.description: Key id (daemon fingerprint or sub-key id)
